errors.text_span: Линията за „Question answering“ е светлозелена с маркери във формата на триъгълник, сочещ нагоре
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the marker for 'Question answering' as an upward-pointing triangle. In the figure, the 'Question answering' line uses downward-pointing triangle markers. Upward-pointing triangles are used for 'Text generation'.
